name: zcode-rtl
description: Persian RTL fix for the ZCode Desktop chat UI, with Vazirmatn font, scaled markdown headings and mirrored arrows in RTL text (tested through 3.17.x). The Plugin Management toggle is a LIVE master switch (background heartbeat applies/strips the fix in real time, reload-free both ways, and always runs the currently installed payload — a plugin refresh takes effect without killing the daemon). Falls back to /rtl-fix on|off. Survives app updates — no app file is modified.
